tasks.description: Fix the off-by-one error in the pagination function. The function `get_page(items, page_num, page_size)` returns one too many items on the last page when the total item count is not evenly divisible by page_size.
tasks.ground_truth: Change `items[start:start + page_size]` to `items[start:min(start + page_size, len(items))]` in the get_page function.

tasks.description: The user authentication middleware fails silently when the JWT token is expired. Instead of returning a 401 status, it passes the request through as unauthenticated. Fix the token validation to properly reject expired tokens.
tasks.ground_truth: Add an expiration check in the verify_token function: if token payload 'exp' < current_time, raise AuthenticationError('Token expired'). Update the middleware to catch this error and return 401.

tasks.description: Implement a rate limiter middleware that limits each API key to 100 requests per minute using a sliding window algorithm. The middleware should return 429 Too Many Requests when the limit is exceeded and include a Retry-After header.
tasks.ground_truth: Implement a SlidingWindowRateLimiter class that tracks request timestamps per API key in a deque. On each request, remove timestamps older than 60 seconds, check if count >= 100, and either allow or reject with 429 and Retry-After header.
